Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the IMDb release info for Saajan Bina Suhagan—stating a USA 1983 release as the earliest—despite the visible IMDb data showing an India 1978 release. By prioritizing a later regional (US) date over the earliest documented release and failing to reconcile this with Wikipedia’s 1978 entry, the Planner concluded that Taxi zum Klo (1980) came first. This incorrect criterion and misreading led to the wrong ordering.
